note: HAND-AUTHORED source for the `patterns` section of component-registry.json. Templates are the layout/composition layer: Figma component sets that govern how a container is laid out, each bound to one `size / semantics` token family. Card, Section, Modal, and Table are exported from `@/templates`, while `Template/Surface container` has no standalone code export; they are kept here separately from `components` because their MDX files do not carry `figmaMeta`. Edit here, then run `npm run generate:component-registry`.

Template/Surface container.notes: Content is a real native SLOT (verified via the Plugin API: type === 'SLOT'). The '◇ Content — convert this frame to a slot' line still sitting inside it is stale instructional copy, not an unconverted frame — cosmetic cleanup only, it does not block write-back.

Template/Table.notes: All three are real native SLOTs (verified via the Plugin API: type === 'SLOT'). The '◇ … — convert this frame to a slot' lines inside them are stale instructional copy, not unconverted frames — cosmetic cleanup only, they do not block write-back.
